mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y GDPC1 growth accelerates by >1pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50, indicating a contraction in manufacturing activity, it signals an impending economic slowdown that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 50 but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as a 0.5pp rise over 3 months, signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, signaling a restrictive monetary policy, it will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as higher borrowing costs weigh on economic activity.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (proxied by HOUST) decline by more than 10% year-over-year, signaling a weakening housing market, it will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the housing slowdown weighs on economic activity.
failure_condition: Y/Y HOUST decline > 10% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 7% and rising, signaling a weak labor market, it will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the weak labor market weighs on consumer spending.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 7% and rising but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real retail sales (RSAFS) grow by more than 5% year-over-year while the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, signaling strong consumer demand, it will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y RSAFS growth > 5% and UNRATE < 5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3% while the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2%, signaling an inflation overshoot relative to the policy rate, it will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the market anticipates tighter monetary policy.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 3% and FEDFUNDS < 2% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of triggered instances.
